verdict.rationale: Rootly Workflows is a documented automation engine that runs actions automatically from trigger events and run conditions, with 152 action types. It handles channel creation, stakeholder updates, ticket filing and retros without manual work. AI SRE investigation rules also let Rootly AI investigate alerts automatically in the background, steered by team-specific instructions. Missing for 10: no evidence of time-based or recurring scheduled triggers (only event-triggered runs are documented), and no independent or hands-on corroboration that workflows or AI SRE run reliably unattended.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Workflows are Rootly's automation engine. They let you run structured actions automatically (or manually) based on: **Trigger events**
Automation that runs your response: channels created, stakeholders updated, tickets filed, retros started, the same way every time.
Investigation rules decide which alerts Rootly AI SRE investigates automatically and which alert-specific instructions it applies
Reference for all 152 Rootly workflow action types, grouped by category: Slack, Google Chat, Jira, on-call, AI, and incident operations.
AI Instructions guide Rootly Agents on how to carry out tasks and respond to requests, so every automated interaction works the way your teams do.
